_doc: Bot cycle 57.3 (M3): paired goldfish test records; built by scripts/grixis_paired.py; schema test.schema.json.

records.mulligan: keep 2-5 lands with (lands + mana sources costing <= 2) >= 3; otherwise mulligan; always keep at 5 cards or fewer; bottom (London): excess lands beyond 4 first, then the highest mana value nonlands
records.seat: multiplayer, seat-agnostic (no turn-1 draw skip, CR 103.8c); first mulligan free (CR 103.5c)

results.method: paired goldfish, 2000 games on identical shuffles; diff = challenger - baseline per game; CI95 = mean ± 1.96·sd/√n of the per-game differences

limitations: Goldfish: one player, no opponents, no interaction, no combat; results are about the deck's own development, never win rates.

Not modelled: tutors, card draw and selection beyond the natural draw, treasures, rituals and one-shot mana (Lotus Petal, Mana Vault, Lion's Eye Diamond); a swap whose value is card draw, interaction or a tutor effect is invisible here.
Conditional fast mana (Chrome Mox, Mox Diamond, Mox Opal, Mox Amber, Springleaf Drum, Paradise Mantle) is treated as unconditional; 'enters tapped unless ...' lands as untapped.
Combo pieces are 'assembled' when drawn; Commander Spellbook 'requires' conditions and the combo's own mana needs beyond the cards' mana values are ignored.
Fixed policy: commander first, then mana sources, then highest mana value; keep/bottom rule as recorded in 'mulligan'.
